topic_identity_scope.semantics: The frozen 40-Topic catalog has 39 Topics represented by the 624 observed eligible Exercises. The inactive catalog Topic has no final eligible response row and cannot receive an observed delta.

chronological_split.ordering: time_done ascending with original ProblemLog source row as stable tie-breaker

global_parameter_policy: Frozen development-refit global parameters; no final response updates mu, beta_exercise, or ExerciseRate.

personal_calibration.hierarchical_delta_l2: Use the lambda_delta selected and frozen by development_model_selection.

fallback_policy.when: Exercise has fewer than 5 development-refit interactions or is absent from the frozen development Exercise map.

evaluation_update_policy: Evaluation computes predictions and metrics only; it never invokes optimizer or updates theta_student or delta_student_topic.
